name: hyperdrive
title: Hyperdrive
description: Bring-your-own Postgres or MySQL to Lunora actions via Cloudflare Hyperdrive — a SqlClient over postgres.js, node-postgres, or mysql2. Includes createHyperdrive() binding reader and adapter helpers, plus a parameterised internalAction to copy.
docs: Wire the adapter in your action handler: import { createHyperdrive, fromPostgresJs } from "@lunora/hyperdrive"; then const { connectionString } = createHyperdrive(env.HYPERDRIVE); const sql = fromPostgresJs(async () => (await import("postgres")).default(connectionString, { fetch_types: false, max: 5 })); const rows = await sql.query("select id from users where org = $1", [orgId]); — the adapter takes a loader that runs on the first query, which keeps the driver out of the Worker's startup graph (do not import postgres statically). The adapters return a SqlClient whose only method is query(text, params); it is NOT a tagged template. Values always go in params behind positional placeholders. The scaffolded queryUsers is an internalAction (server-only) on purpose: an action is public RPC, so a client-callable database read is an identity oracle. Deliberately no runQuery(sql) helper ships — see the source file header.
